status: DRAFT — AWAITING OWNER SIGNATURE; NO FREEZE, NO GRANT, NO RUN
purpose: Record Path A and resolve whether C1/C4 are pre-freeze admissibility gates or post-freeze VOID gates.

decisions.decision: Path A is the A1 estimand: the representative eligible pre-37 cycle-membership directed-edge effect.
decisions.path_b: Not selected; a separate future experiment requiring a new selector, target artifact and registered design.
decisions.effect: The existing six target sets are retained as the Path A draft; no target regeneration.
C1/C4 are observed only after the planned cells run; either failing or being unmeasurable makes the run A1 VOID — C1/C4 before any model is read.

decisions.decision: freeze -> grant -> run -> measure C1/C4 -> PASS or VOID
decisions.effect: Preserves preregistration discipline and prevents the observed denominator from influencing what is frozen.

decisions.decision: The result is provisional; target identity is not.
decisions.effect: The targets are fixed before outcomes; a VOID does not unfreeze, re-select or license a retry.

decisions.decision: C1/C4 failure or unmeasurability is VOID, not NOT IDENTIFIED or UNSATISFIABLE.
decisions.effect: No model label, no M1 branch and no scientific claim are read from the run.

path_a.estimand: representative eligible pre-37 cycle-membership directed-edge effect
path_a.status: RECORDED IN PROTOCOL; CONFIRMATION PENDING SIGNATURE

path_b.effect: high-carrier-propensity, hard-edge or carrier-enriched effect; new selector, target artifact and registered design

why_pre_freeze_fails: Freeze first, then measure C1/C4, then freeze again is circular.
Run an unregistered diagnostic first lets the observed denominator influence what is frozen.
Assume the planned denominator and freeze on it weakens the measurement claim.
why_post_freeze_works: Targets are fixed before outcomes are seen.
C1/C4 are observed only after the planned cells run.
Failing or being unmeasurable makes it VOID without changing the targets.
No model is read before the validity decision.

gate_order: assemble C1 + C4 from actual parts
both pass -> read C7/C8 and the remaining gates; either fails or is unmeasurable -> A1 VOID — C1/C4

provisional_freeze.meaning: The result is provisional until C1/C4 pass; the target identity is not provisional, and a VOID does not unfreeze it.

void_conditions.condition: No paired-control denominator is available for a required seed or required row. A missing denominator is not zero.
The observed minimum paired-control denominator is below 60 on any seed or path, even if every available row is retained. Applies only if the separate 60-row floor proposal is adopted.
On any seed, A- carrier preservation is below 0.95, or K- served preservation is below 0.95.
The non-target stream is absent, incomplete, or has no measurable paired delta.
Any measurable non-target A, K or Y neighbour delta exceeds 0.05.
Required cell parts are missing, duplicated, or cannot be paired for C1/C4. The gate is unmeasurable; it is not a zero-row pass.

denominator_floor.if_not_adopted: The C1_DENOMINATOR_BELOW_FLOOR condition is omitted and C1 is read at 0.95 on the observed denominator; a 59/59 result would pass.
denominator_floor.if_adopted: The observed minimum paired-control denominator below 60 on any seed or path makes the run VOID, even at 59/59.

void_meaning: The experiment did not produce an admissible comparison.
No causal model is selected: no M-K, M-N, M-S or M-R label.
No M1 branch is assigned, and no V2, capability, transfer, external-advantage or generalization claim may be read.
C7 and C8 are not adjudicated; if not already evaluated, they are reported as NOT ADJUDICATED — RUN VOID.
The run is not a negative result and is not evidence for or against any model; it is not a null finding or failed replication.
Observed C1 denominators and C4 row counts are retained for audit; a missing denominator is reported as missing, never as 0.0.
The planned seeds and cells are consumed; no substitute seed, extra cell or post-hoc target may be added.
No row may be dropped, no threshold changed, no target re-selected and no denominator expanded after the failure is seen.
Parts and observed counts may support instrument diagnostics, but may not be re-labelled as an A1 result.
The target freeze remains recorded; a VOID does not return the attempt to an unfrozen state or authorise a second attempt under the same registration.
void_does_not_mean: That the carrier model or the two-path model is false.
That C1 or C4 can never pass.
That the two-path model is untestable in principle.
That a new selector, new target count or new threshold is licensed under the same registration.
That a failed C1 may be re-read as a C4 problem, or a failed C4 as a C1 problem.
That the run may be reported as a near pass or a descriptively supportive result.
That a second attempt is authorised. A further attempt requires a new registered design, a fresh seed block and a new dated owner grant.

status_distinctions.when: The run did not execute: missing target set, missing rule, or no grant.
status_distinctions.records: A preparation or authorisation stop, not an experimental outcome.

status_distinctions.when: The planned run executed but the C1/C4 validity test failed or was unmeasurable.
status_distinctions.records: No admissible comparison; no model read.

status_distinctions.when: The current C1 result-gate failure when the comparison exists but model separation is not achieved.
status_distinctions.records: A scientific result-gate outcome under the current disposition.

status_distinctions.when: The current disposition for a gate that cannot be measured under the registered design.
status_distinctions.records: A design/measurement limit under the current disposition.

open_after_signature: The target freeze act for the Path A targets and manifest block.
adoption_effect: Record Path A in the owner decision record.
Resolve C1/C4 as post-freeze VOID gates, not pre-freeze admissibility gates.
Record the Path A target freeze and manifest target block in a separate dated act.
Update C1 failure and unmeasurable dispositions in benchmarks/a1_gate_readiness.py from NOT IDENTIFIED / UNSATISFIABLE to VOID, and regenerate the readiness artifact and page.
Map a C1/C4 FAIL from a1_result.assemble to VOID in the assembly caller and carry the reason codes.
Update the manual, pre-freeze checklist and changelog in the same act.
not_evidence: An unsigned owner decision memo and a definition of VOID. No cell has run; this is not an A1 result, freeze, grant or capability claim.
